s1.desc: a kitchen with a long bright teal counter in front of a pale, softly blurred wall

s2.desc: a kitchen with a long bright teal counter in front of a dim grey, softly blurred wall

spans.view: with a wooden board of sushi, a stemmed glass and a soy sauce bottle on the counter in front of her

beats.text: Polly sits behind the counter and pushes the board of sushi forward, looking ahead with a smile
Polly closes her eyes in a pleased smile behind the sushi board
Polly picks up the stemmed glass and raises it beside her, smiling with bright eyes
Polly leans in and clinks her glass against a glass held out by a flipper reaching in from the right
Polly sits back with her glass raised, smiling
Polly lifts a piece of sushi to her beak and pops it in
Polly chews with her eyes closed and a blissful smile, swaying gently with her glass in her flipper

beats.text: Polly shuffles in from the right with heavy-lidded eyes and stops behind the counter
Polly raises a flipper to her beak and gives a big sleepy yawn
Polly stands behind the counter with droopy half-closed eyes, swaying slightly
Polly bends down behind the counter and comes back up holding a bag of seaweed snacks
Polly holds the bag of seaweed snacks up beside her, staring blankly with heavy-lidded eyes
Polly pulls out a piece of seaweed with one flipper and stuffs it into her beak
Polly chews slowly with heavy-lidded eyes, holding the open bag in front of her
